bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
cd "$repo"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 70
git fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/fix/chat-three-topic-selector-20261114 >/dev/null
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = db27cab03e08c435c056f72d960a67e183c0f48f || exit 71
tmp="$(mktemp -d)";trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
cp scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py "$tmp/old.py"
git show db27cab03e08c435c056f72d960a67e183c0f48f:scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py > "$tmp/new.py"
python3 - "$tmp/old.py" "$tmp/new.py" "$tmp/updated.py" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys,ast
old=Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
cand=Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text()
start='                                raw = [getattr(screen.reply_markup.rows[i].buttons[1]'
end='                                await screen.click(text="🔙 戻る")'
assert old.count(start)==cand.count(start)==1
assert old.count(end)==cand.count(end)==1
a=old.index(start);b=old.index(end,a)
c=cand.index(start);d=cand.index(end,c)
result=old[:a]+cand[c:d]+old[b:]
ast.parse(result)
Path(sys.argv[3]).write_text(result)
PY
cp "$tmp/updated.py" scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py
chmod 600 scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service
sleep 3
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 72
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 73
timeout 40s python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 74
chat="$(timeout 70s python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py chat_selector_smoke 2>&1 || true)"
invite="$(timeout 70s python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py invite_selector_smoke 2>&1 || true)"
{
 echo "CHAT_INVITE_LIVE_BUTTON_RESULT"
 echo "CHAT=$(printf '%s' "$chat" | grep '^USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=' | head -1 || echo UNKNOWN)"
 echo "INVITE=$(printf '%s' "$invite" | grep '^USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=' | head -1 || echo UNKNOWN)"
 echo "INVITE_ERROR=$(printf '%s' "$invite" | grep '^USERBOT_TEST_ERROR=' | head -1 || echo NONE)"
 echo "USERBOT_ACTIVE=$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)"
 echo "USERBOT_ENABLED=$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)"
 echo "BOT_IMAGE=$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
} | gh issue comment 7 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
printf '%s' "$chat" | grep -q 'USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=PASS'
printf '%s' "$invite" | grep -q 'USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=PASS'
